## 1. Executive Catalog Overview

This manifest documents the complete, high-resolution 24-screenshot visual catalog of [https://trustio.com.br](https://trustio.com.br). The catalog covers:
- **16 Desktop Captures**: 1440 × 900 @ 2x deviceScaleFactor (rendered at 2880 × 1800 px, plus 2 full-page scrolls up to 29,970 px).
- **8 Mobile Captures**: 390 × 844 @ 3x deviceScaleFactor (rendered at 1170 × 2532 px, native iPhone Retina DPR with touch emulation).
- **Pre-Submission States**: Forms captured in pre-submission states with zero credentials submitted and zero payment transactions initiated, strictly honoring the safety guardrail.

## 3. Deep-Dive Screenshot Analyses

### 3.1 Desktop Viewport Analyses (1440 × 900 @ 2x DPR)

#### `01-home-hero-desktop.png`
- **Rendered Dimensions**: 2880 × 1800 px (DPR 2.0)
- **File Size**: 1,349,602 bytes (~1.3 MB)
- **URL**: `https://trustio.com.br/`
- **Visual Inspection**:
  - The navigation header contains 11 interactive elements: 9 links (Plataforma, Modelos Poderosos, VoiceAI, Segurança, Implantação, Jurídico, Planos, Lista de espera, Manifesto), an "Entrar" link, a "Falar com a Trustio" primary button, and a theme toggle.
  - The hero H1 (`font-size: clamp(82px, 11.8vw, 170px)`) renders at maximum scale (170px), dominating the upper 70% of the screen.
  - Below the H1, the subtitle begins: "Para você: chat privado sem censura e um agente que executa tarefas. Para a sua empresa: modelos, agentes e aplicações em ambiente..."
  - **Critical Usability Defect**: The primary conversion buttons (`.hero-actions`: "Criar conta grátis", "Ver mentoria e implantação", "Ver os dois caminhos") are located at Y > 920px. On a standard 1440x900 viewport, **zero conversion buttons are visible above the fold**.

#### `02-home-full-desktop.png`
- **Rendered Dimensions**: 2880 × 29,970 px (DPR 2.0)
- **File Size**: 6,462,492 bytes (~6.3 MB)
